description: Triggers Federated Averaging (FedAvg) over all client updates currently in the staging buffer. Produces a new global model version with sample-weighted averaged coefficients, intercepts, and scaler parameters. The buffer is cleared after successful aggregation.

400.detail: No updates in buffer to aggregate. Submit client weights via /model/sync-weights first.

notes: Requires at least one client update in the buffer. The new model version is incremented from the previous global version. After aggregation, clients should call /local/refresh-weights to pull the updated global model. The FedAvg formula weights each client's contribution by its sample_count relative to total_samples.
